title: Even with Agent mode full accuses enabled, whenever an agent creates a file, a human must approve it each time.
body:

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

Even with Agent mode full accuses enabled, whenever an agent creates a file, a human must approve it each time:

Enable [Agent (Full Access)].
Ask the agent to create files.
This requires human approval. When creating many files, it becomes extremely cumbersome.
